in_english.long_meaning: In Christian tradition, the name Aquila is derived from the Latin word for eagle, symbolizing strength, courage, and vision. It is associated with the New Testament book of Acts, where Aquila and his wife Priscilla are mentioned as hosts to the Apostle Paul. The name is also linked to the Latin word for feminine, emphasizing the qualities of compassion and nurturing. In modern times, the name Aquila has gained popularity as a unique and powerful choice for Christian parents.

data.cultural_impact: Aquila was a name utilized by the early Christians as a tribute to the Roman icon of the eagle sent by Jupiter. The name symbolizes strength, power, and endorsement from God, just as the eagle represented imperial and divine protection during that era.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, St. Aquila was an apostle who, along with his wife Priscilla, represented displaced Jews who became converts to Christianity. They accompanied St. Paul on his missionary journeys (Acts 18:24-26). Their journey symbolizes faith, growth, and following the call of God despite adversities.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aquila was a Christian missionary who travelled with Paul. The name Aquila carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
Aquila was a Roman citizen of Jewish descent who moved to Corinth with his wife Priscilla and became a Christian.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's world, the name Aquila continues to be cherished by Christian families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.

name_in_real_life.story: James Aquila, a minister in New York, United States, shares that their name Aquila meaning "Eagle" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Aquila represents the bold and agile eagle in Christian symbolism. This name signifies strength, freedom, and the ability to soar above adversity, reflecting the spirit of the early Christian missionaries who spread the gospel and faced persecution with courage.
